html:
Pakperk is a mobile arXiv reader. You can browse and read as a guest; an account is needed only for features that belong to you, such as your synchronized Library and its To Read queue, posting public comments, blocking, and account deletion.

The release targets Android 7.0 / API 24 or newer and iOS 15 or newer.

Availability note

Pakperk Production v0.0 is currently a release candidate. The checked-in production configuration keeps accounts, Library, and comments off until the service completes its operational, safety, legal, device, signing, and store reviews. A released build may therefore show only guest reading. The app should never advertise a disabled capability as available.

Install or update Pakperk only through an official App Store or Google Play listing published by the service operator. If the operator has not linked an official listing, Production v0.0 is not yet publicly available; do not trust an arbitrary download or sideload as a released build.

Read papers

The app has three main destinations:

  • Read contains the paper feed and reader.
  • Library contains your synchronized papers and To Read queue when those features are enabled. Otherwise it explains that Library is unavailable or asks you to sign in.
  • You contains guest information or, when accounts are enabled, sign-in, profile, a Library shortcut, My comments, Blocked users, Settings, Sign out, and Delete account controls.

Library's canonical in-app location is /library. After an upgrade, an older restored route that still points to /you/library redirects to the standalone Library destination automatically.

In Read:

  1. Move vertically for the next or previous paper.
  2. Move horizontally—or use the labeled stage controls—between Abstract, Introduction, and Connections. Chat opens separately from the Introduction stage.
  3. Use the arXiv action to open the original record. Pakperk does not replace the source paper and is not affiliated with arXiv.

The first committed move into Introduction may start normal paper preparation when that paper has not been processed. Prefetching or merely viewing a feed card does not start preparation. Preparation can take time and may expose a retry if a dependency is temporarily unavailable.

Chat is scoped to the selected paper and should cite the evidence supplied with its answer. It may decline to answer when the paper does not support the question. Connections explains selected references; use the source links to inspect the original work.

In a strict release, Introduction, Chat, or Connections can also be unavailable while online when the paper's license or prepared capabilities do not permit that derived content. Metadata and the original arXiv link remain available.

Offline and cached reading

Pakperk opens cached or bundled metadata before waiting for the network, then refreshes in place when connectivity returns. The app remembers the current paper, reader stage, scroll position, and other bounded navigation state.

In a strict release, offline metadata and original arXiv links remain available, but cached Introduction, Connections, chat answers, and derived capabilities may be hidden when the app cannot revalidate their content policy. That is an intentional rights-protection boundary.

Settings and data on this device

Open You → Settings to choose system/light/dark appearance, inspect reading cache usage, view licenses, or clear local data.

  • Clear reading cache removes rebuildable feeds, generated reading views, cached discussions, and anonymous chat cache. It preserves your account, saved papers, drafts, pending synchronization, settings, and current reading position.
  • Clear all data signs out and removes every local paper, local save, draft, pending change, setting, reading position, and anonymous device identity from that device. Data already synchronized to your Pakperk account remains on the server.
  • Delete account is a separate server-side action. Use it when you want to remove the account and associated server data; clearing local data alone does not do that.

Accounts and sign-in

When accounts are enabled, sign-in opens the system browser and uses the service's identity provider. Pakperk does not ask you to type a provider password into the app. Complete email verification or recovery with that provider.

Your Pakperk profile contains a public handle and optional display name. A handle is normalized to lowercase, must contain 3–30 lowercase ASCII letters, digits, or underscores, and can be set only once. Some actions require acceptance of the current Terms and Community Guidelines. If the provider or network is temporarily unavailable, the app may retain a limited offline account state while disabling remote mutations until your identity can be verified again.

Signing out removes account-owned local data and secure session material from the device. Public cached papers and reader restoration can remain so guest reading still works.

Library and To Read

When Library is enabled, use the paper save control to add or remove a paper from To Read. Saved papers appear in the standalone Library destination; baseline To Read entries appear in Inbox. Changes appear optimistically on the device and sync when the network and verified account are available.

In the baseline To Read flow, removing a paper offers Undo as a new synchronized action. You can refresh Library by pulling down; offline and pending states remain visible instead of pretending a remote change has completed.

If the expanded Library capability is enabled for your build, Library can also offer Read next, Reading, Reviewed, and Archived states, private save notes, Lists & tags, reminders, and private on-device History. Those controls appear only when their matching capabilities are enabled. Opening a paper never changes its Library state automatically.

If library writes are temporarily paused, existing saved papers remain readable but save/remove actions wait or fail with an explanation. Saving a paper never starts its preparation.

Public comments and safety

When comments are enabled, guests can read published discussion. Posting requires an active verified account, a public handle, and acceptance of the current Terms and Community Guidelines.

  • Comments are public plain text, not private notes or rendered Markdown.
  • A normalized comment may contain at most 2,000 Unicode characters, 8,000 UTF-8 bytes, and three links.
  • The app rejects unsafe control characters and pathological pastes before saving or sending them.
  • Drafts belong to one account and paper, remain local until sent, and never auto-send.
  • A new or edited comment may be held for review.
  • You can edit or delete your own comment while your account is eligible.

Open You → My comments to revisit your posts. A comment labeled Under review is visible only to you and authorized moderators until it is published or resolved.

Use the three distinct safety actions deliberately:

  • Report comment sends a private content report. It does not hide or block the author automatically.
  • Report user sends a private account-level report. It does not create a block.
  • Block user immediately removes that author's comments from your view and synchronizes the block to your account. It does not create a report.

You can manage blocked users from You. Serious or urgent safety, privacy, copyright, accessibility, or legal concerns belong on the published support page. Do not paste passwords, tokens, private keys, or an entire harmful comment into a support request; include the relevant operation or comment ID when available.

The complete rules are in the Community Guidelines.

Delete your account

When deletion is enabled, open You and choose the account-deletion action. The service requires a recent sign-in so a stolen old session cannot delete the account. A public web deletion route is also provided for the released service.

Deletion disables access immediately and queues removal of the provider identity, profile, Library data including To Read, comments, blocks, reports, and pending account-owned work. The operation is retry-safe. A restricted signed deletion record is retained long enough to prevent a restored backup from silently recreating the account; it is not a copy of your profile or comments.

Use the built-in support action if deletion is stalled; it includes a validated request identifier when one is available. If the app or web page explicitly shows an operation ID, retain it and send no credentials. See the Privacy Notice for retention details.

Privacy in plain language

  • Guest reading does not require an account.
  • Access tokens stay in memory; refresh/session material uses the platform secure store rather than general preferences or the content database.
  • Pakperk operational telemetry excludes comment/report text, paper full text, prompts, chat messages, handles, email, provider subjects, and tokens.
  • Pakperk does not collect contacts, precise location, an advertising ID, an avatar, or a personalized ranking profile for v0.0.
  • Apple or Google may separately collect native crash information according to device settings and their policies.

The authoritative release-candidate policy text is the Privacy Notice; its jurisdiction/contact approval remains a release gate until publication.

Accessibility and navigation

Pakperk supports labeled alternatives to swipe gestures, light and dark themes, reduced motion, large text, screen-reader semantics, keyboard focus, and system back navigation. Phones use bottom navigation; larger layouts use a labeled navigation rail. If motion is reduced at the OS level, opening and reader transitions should remain bounded and understandable without relying on animation.

Troubleshooting

  • The app opens older papers: you are seeing the cached-first experience; reconnect and retry the feed refresh.
  • Introduction or Connections is unavailable: strict content policy may be masking derived material because it cannot be revalidated or the paper's rights/capabilities do not permit it. This can happen online or offline. The original arXiv link remains available.
  • You shows guest information: the installed build may have accounts disabled, or you may need to sign in again after an invalid session.
  • Library is unavailable or comments are missing: those capabilities may be disabled for the release or environment; guest reading should still work.
  • Comment sending is paused: correct any visible length/character error, reconnect, verify the account, or wait for the publication switch to reopen. Existing discussion and safety actions should remain available when only new publication is paused.
  • A Library or comment change has not appeared on another device: keep the app online long enough to verify the account and complete synchronization, then refresh the destination view.
  • Account deletion asks for sign-in: complete the recent-authentication step in the system browser and retry.

For a released service, use https://pakperk.app/support. The corresponding repository policy is Support and Safety. A placeholder or unmonitored support route blocks release.

Pakperk 是一款移动端 arXiv 阅读器。您可以以访客身份浏览和阅读论文；只有使用归属于您的功能时才需要账户，例如同步您的 Library 及其中的 To Read 队列、发表评论、屏蔽用户和删除账户。

此版本支持 Android 7.0 / API 24 或更高版本，以及 iOS 15 或更高版本。

可用性说明

Pakperk Production v0.0 目前仍是发布候选版本。已纳入版本控制的生产配置会将账户、Library 和评论功能保持关闭，直到服务完成运营、安全、法律、设备、签名和应用商店审核。因此，正式发布的构建可能只提供访客阅读。应用绝不应把已关闭的功能宣传为可用。

请只通过服务运营方发布的 App Store 或 Google Play 官方页面安装或更新 Pakperk。如果运营方尚未提供官方页面的链接，说明 Production v0.0 还没有公开发布；不要把来路不明的下载文件或侧载版本当作正式发布版本。

阅读论文

应用有三个主要入口：

  • Read 包含论文 Feed 和阅读器。
  • Library 在相关功能启用后显示您同步的论文和 To Read 队列。否则，它会说明 Library 尚不可用，或提示您登录。
  • You 显示访客信息；启用账户后，其中还会提供登录、个人资料、Library 快捷入口、My comments、Blocked users、Settings、Sign out 和 Delete account 控件。

Library 在应用内的规范位置是 /library。升级后，如果恢复的旧路由仍指向 /you/library，应用会自动将其重定向到独立的 Library 入口。

在 Read 中：

  1. 纵向滑动即可切换到下一篇或上一篇论文。
  2. 横向滑动，或使用带文字标签的阶段控件，即可在 Abstract、Introduction 和 Connections 之间切换。Chat 不属于这三个横向阶段，而是从 Introduction 单独打开。
  3. 使用 arXiv 操作可打开原始论文记录。Pakperk 不会取代原论文，也不隶属于 arXiv。

如果论文尚未处理，首次真正进入 Introduction 时可能会启动常规论文预处理。预取或仅仅查看 Feed 卡片都不会启动预处理。预处理可能需要一些时间；如果依赖服务暂时不可用，界面可能会提供重试入口。

Chat 的范围仅限当前选中的论文，并应引用回答所依据的证据。如果论文内容无法支持问题，Chat 可能会拒绝作答。Connections 会说明选定的参考文献；请通过来源链接查看原始研究。

在严格策略的发布版本中，如果论文许可或已经准备就绪的功能不允许提供相应派生内容，那么即使设备在线，Introduction、Chat 或 Connections 也可能不可用。元数据和原始 arXiv 链接仍然可用。

离线与缓存阅读

Pakperk 会先打开缓存或内置的元数据，而不必等待网络；连接恢复后，再在当前界面原地刷新。应用会记住当前论文、阅读器阶段、滚动位置，以及范围受限的其他导航状态。

在严格策略的发布版本中，离线元数据和原始 arXiv 链接仍然可用；但是，当应用无法重新验证内容策略时，缓存的 Introduction、Connections、Chat 回答和派生功能可能会被隐藏。这是有意设置的权利保护边界。

设置和本设备上的数据

打开 You → Settings，可以选择跟随系统、浅色或深色外观，查看阅读缓存占用和开源许可，或清除本地数据。

  • Clear reading cache 会移除可重新构建的 Feed、生成的阅读视图、缓存的讨论和匿名 Chat 缓存。您的账户、已保存论文、草稿、待同步变更、设置和当前阅读位置都会保留。
  • Clear all data 会退出登录，并从这台设备中移除所有本地论文、本地保存记录、草稿、待处理变更、设置、阅读位置和匿名设备标识。已经同步到您的 Pakperk 账户的数据仍会保留在服务器上。
  • Delete account 是另一项服务端操作。如果您希望删除账户及其关联的服务端数据，请使用此操作；只清除本地数据不会删除账户。

账户与登录

启用账户后，登录流程会打开系统浏览器，并使用服务的身份提供商。Pakperk 不会要求您在应用内输入身份提供商的密码。电子邮件验证或账户恢复应在该身份提供商处完成。

您的 Pakperk 个人资料包含一个公开用户名和一个可选的显示名称。用户名会规范化为小写，必须由 3–30 个小写 ASCII 字母、数字或下划线组成，并且只能设置一次。某些操作要求您接受当前版本的服务条款和社区准则。如果身份提供商或网络暂时不可用，应用可能会保留受限的离线账户状态，同时停用远程写操作，直到能够再次验证您的身份。

退出登录会从设备中移除归属于账户的本地数据和安全会话材料。公开缓存的论文和阅读器恢复状态可以保留，因此访客阅读仍能正常使用。

Library 与 To Read

启用 Library 后，可使用论文的保存控件将论文加入 To Read 或从中移除。已保存的论文会显示在独立的 Library 入口中；基础版 To Read 中的条目会显示在 Inbox 中。变更会先立即显示在设备上，并在网络和已验证账户均可用时同步。

在基础版 To Read 流程中，移除论文后，界面会提供 Undo；选择它会创建一项新的同步操作。在 Library 中下拉即可刷新；离线和待同步状态会如实显示，而不会假装远程变更已经完成。

如果您所用的构建启用了扩展 Library 功能，Library 还可能提供 Read next、Reading、Reviewed 和 Archived 状态，以及私密保存备注、Lists & tags、提醒和仅保存在本设备上的私密 History。只有相应功能启用后，这些控件才会出现。打开论文绝不会自动改变其 Library 状态。

如果 Library 写入暂时暂停，现有的已保存论文仍可阅读，但保存或移除操作会等待，或在失败时说明原因。保存论文绝不会启动论文预处理。

公开评论与安全

启用评论后，访客可以阅读已发布的讨论。发表评论需要一个有效且已验证的账户、公开用户名，并且您必须接受当前版本的服务条款和社区准则。

  • 评论是公开的纯文本，不是私密笔记，也不会按 Markdown 渲染。
  • 规范化后的评论最多可包含 2,000 个 Unicode 字符、8,000 个 UTF-8 字节和三个链接。
  • 在保存或发送之前，应用会拒绝不安全的控制字符，以及可能导致处理异常的粘贴内容。
  • 每份草稿只属于一个账户和一篇论文，在发送前始终留在本设备上，并且绝不会自动发送。
  • 新评论或编辑后的评论可能会进入待审核状态。
  • 只要您的账户仍具备相应资格，您就可以编辑或删除自己的评论。

打开 You → My comments 可再次查看您发表的内容。标为 Under review 的评论只有您本人和获授权的审核员可见，直至该评论发布或审核处理完毕。

请明确区分以下三项安全操作：

  • Report comment 会提交一份私密的内容举报。它不会自动隐藏或屏蔽作者。
  • Report user 会提交一份私密的账户级举报。它不会同时屏蔽该用户。
  • Block user 会立即从您的界面移除该作者的评论，并把屏蔽状态同步到您的账户。它不会同时创建举报。

您可以从 You 管理已屏蔽用户。严重或紧急的安全、隐私、版权、无障碍或法律问题，应通过已发布的支持页面处理。请勿在支持请求中粘贴密码、令牌、私钥或整段有害评论；如果有相应的操作 ID 或评论 ID，请提供该 ID。

完整规则请参阅社区准则。

删除您的账户

启用删除功能后，请打开 You 并选择删除账户操作。服务会要求您完成一次近期登录验证，避免被盗用的旧会话删除账户。正式发布的服务还会提供公开的网页删除路由。

删除操作会立即禁用账户访问，并将身份提供商中的身份记录、个人资料、包括 To Read 在内的 Library 数据、评论、屏蔽记录、举报和归属于账户的待处理工作加入删除队列。此操作可以安全重试。系统会将一条访问严格受限且带签名的删除记录保留足够长的时间，以防恢复的备份在不知情的情况下重新创建账户；该记录不是您个人资料或评论的副本。

如果删除流程停滞，请使用内置支持操作；如有可用的请求标识符，该操作会自动附上经过验证的标识符。如果应用或网页明确显示操作 ID，请保留该 ID，但不要发送任何凭据。保留期限详见隐私声明。

隐私说明

  • 访客阅读不需要账户。
  • 访问令牌只保留在内存中；刷新令牌和会话材料存放在平台安全存储中，而不是通用偏好设置或内容数据库中。
  • Pakperk 的运营遥测不包含评论或举报文本、论文全文、提示词、Chat 消息、公开用户名、电子邮件、身份提供商主体标识或令牌。
  • 在 v0.0 中，Pakperk 不会收集联系人、精确位置、广告 ID、头像或个性化排序档案。
  • Apple 或 Google 可能会依据设备设置及其自身政策，另外收集原生崩溃信息。

发布候选版本的权威政策文本是隐私声明；在正式发布之前，其司法辖区和联系方式仍需审批，这项审批仍是发布门禁。

无障碍与导航

Pakperk 为滑动手势提供带文字标签的替代控件，并支持浅色与深色主题、减弱动态效果、大字号、屏幕阅读器语义信息、键盘焦点和系统返回导航。手机使用底部导航栏；较大的布局使用带文字标签的侧边导航栏。如果操作系统已开启减弱动态效果，打开应用以及在阅读器中切换时的转场应保持范围和时长受控，即使不依赖动画也应易于理解。

故障排查

  • 应用打开的是较早的论文： 您看到的是缓存优先体验；请重新连接网络，并再次尝试刷新 Feed。
  • Introduction 或 Connections 不可用： 严格内容策略可能会隐藏派生内容，原因可能是应用无法重新验证这些内容，或论文许可或可用功能不允许提供它们。在线和离线时都可能出现这种情况。原始 arXiv 链接仍然可用。
  • You 显示访客信息： 当前安装版本可能关闭了账户功能；也可能是会话失效后，您需要重新登录。
  • Library 不可用或评论入口缺失： 当前发布版本或环境可能关闭了这些功能；访客阅读应仍然可用。
  • 评论发送已暂停： 请先修正界面上显示的长度或字符错误，再重新连接网络、验证账户，或等待发布开关重新开启。如果只是暂停发布新评论，现有讨论和安全操作应仍然可用。
  • Library 或评论的变更没有出现在另一台设备上： 请让应用保持在线足够长的时间，以完成账户验证和同步，然后刷新相应界面。
  • 删除账户时要求登录： 请在系统浏览器中完成近期身份验证步骤，然后重试。

正式发布服务后，请访问 https://pakperk.app/support。对应的仓库政策是支持与安全。占位支持路由或无人监控的支持路由都会阻止发布。
